Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 下り|くだり as JLPT N3 and its downbound/train-direction sense is specialized. It should not stay in N5 only to close 下 -> くだり coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 長男|ちょうなん as JLPT N2. It is useful family vocabulary later, but N5 already has stronger beginner family anchors and should not force 男 -> なん coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 父母|ふぼ as later-level and the word is formal beside 父, 母, お父さん, and お母さん. Do not keep it only to cover 父 -> ふ.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 生かす|いかす as JLPT N1 and its make-use-of/keep-alive senses are abstract for beginner coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 南北|なんぼく as JLPT N2. N5 already teaches practical direction words, so 南 -> なん should wait for later word review.

Deferred from N5 because dictionary evidence defines 下す|くだす around formal decision, judgement, verdict, and order senses. That is useful later, but it is not a beginner word-card anchor and should not be kept only to close 下 -> くだす coverage.

Removed from the default N5 word deck because 海の水|うみのみず is a transparent compositional phrase, not the dictionary word-card identity for seawater. Dictionary sources list 海水|かいすい for seawater/saltwater, and N5 already covers 水 -> みず through the stronger 水|みず card.

Deferred from N5 because 雨戸|あまど is a useful housing word but source-reviewed as later-level and too specific for beginner study. N5 should not keep it only to close 雨 -> あま coverage.
